scheme_name: Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Meritorious Student Award Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must be a student currently studying in a school
benefits_summary: Cash prizes ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹51,000 are awarded to the top‑scoring Scheduled Caste students in the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations.
